correctness.rationale: Every subset of each graph is enumerated; a separately written breadth-first-search component check agrees with the induced-degree predicate. The attached checker constructs exactly 4,533 disjoint elementary face/coface pairs, verifies all 42,798 oriented Hasse edges are acyclic, and lists precisely one critical vertex and all positive-dimensional critical cells at one dimension (2,3,3,4,5). Forman’s acyclic matching theorem then gives an integral CW wedge with the claimed 1,9,6,1,31 sphere counts. Euler characteristics supply an independent checksum. The result asserts no unverified infinite-family extension.

value.rationale: Agarwal–Basak establish a periodic ordinary-independence homotopy classification for Möbius ladders, making the higher-independence extension a specific natural and unexplored test. The first five cases beyond the exceptional complete-bipartite M6 form an unselected consecutive range, revealing nontrivial changes of sphere dimension and multiplicity and furnishing exact integral benchmark data. This distinguishes homotopy from mere homology or numerical f-vector tables without claiming a general formula.
